## What business question does this answer?

Every addition to this project should trace back to a business question — see `docs/02_Business_Requirements.md §7` for the current list.

## Can the current dataset support it?

Check `docs/03_Dataset_Description.md` and `docs/00_PRD_Scope_Addendum.md` first. Proposals that require data this dataset doesn't have (income, budgets, account balances, etc.) will need a plan for clearly-labeled synthetic data, not silent fabrication — see the addendum's reasoning on why that line matters here.
